def reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation):
    """
    Reverses the order of elements and punctuation while keeping 
    their original pairings.
    """
    # elements と punctuation の両方をスライスを用いて反転させます
    new_elements = elements[::-1]
    new_punctuation = punctuation[::-1]
    
    return (new_elements, new_punctuation)

# テストケース
elements = ["Hello", "world"]
punctuation = ["", "!"]
result = reverse_list_elements(elements, punctuation)

print(f"Input: elements={elements}, punctuation={punctuation}")
print(f"Output: {result}") 
# 期待される出力: (['world', 'Hello'], ['!', ''])
